verdict.rationale: Pricing transparency about seat minimums and billing commitments is a fair question for a SaaS work-management product like Wrike, so the axis applies. However, the cited pricing-page excerpts describe only features (Kanban, dashboards, AI Essentials, integrations, encryption keys). Nothing in them covers minimum seat counts, annual-versus-monthly billing, or commitment terms.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know whether my plan enforces a minimum seat count or annual billing commitment before I subscribe
